notes.title: The Photographer is updated to v1.2.0
notes.content: [p]Hi,[/p][p][/p][p]The Photographer has just been updated to v1.2.0.[/p][p][/p][p]This update added more scenes with all girls near the end of the game. It had a few changes in the walkthrough to separate routes. Please check it carefully.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your support.[/p]

notes.title: The Photographer is updated to v1.1.4
notes.content: [p]Hi,[/p][p][/p][p]The Photographer has just been updated to v1.1.4.[/p][p][/p][p]This update didn't add more scenes, but fixed and improved a lot of animations. A few saves from v1.1.3 doesn't work in v1.1.4, but this is rare.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your support.[/p]
